notes:
Summary: mid-market analytics SaaS (product analytics + help center) — evaluating Redwood Hosted first to validate model quality, then sizing Dedicated for predictable latency/cost. Team: Head of Product (Maya Chen), Staff ML Engineer (Ibrahim Saleh), Infra Lead (Priyanka Rao).

Trial findings (hosted API):
- Latency: p50 chat ~ 170ms, p95 ~ 420ms (short prompts); embeddings jobs longer but batched offline.
- Traffic profile observed during trial week: average QPS ~ 45, peak QPS ~ 210 (during release notes delivery), average concurrency ~ 18, peak concurrency ~ 72.
- Token mix (sample week): 57% short chat requests (40-120 tokens), 28% embeddings (avg 512 tokens batched), 15% long-context summarization/reranking (800-2k tokens).
- Cost sensitivity: high; finance asked for modeled cost at 1M monthly tokens and at 5M monthly tokens.
- Quality: Redwood-curated LLM variant matched or slightly outscored baseline on reranking testset (internal PR metrics).

Dedicated sizing ask / POC scope:
- Target SLOs: 95th latency < 500ms for chat; embeddings throughput 150 QPS when batched; cumulative availability 99.9%.
- Forecast (conservative): baseline QPS 120 sustained, peak QPS 380 during spikes. Concurrency avg 50, peak 220.
- Token mix projection: chat 55%, embeddings 30%, long summaries 15%. Average response token per chat ~ 120.
- Preliminary capacity recommendation: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs for steady-state (handles baseline + autoscaling headroom), add 2 x spare nodes for peak bursts and redundancy; configure burst pool for short TTL to trim cost.
- Autoscaling policy: scale by queue depth + token-rate; aggressive scaling for chat path, delayed scaling for offline batching.

POC milestones proposed:
- Week 1: Dedicated sandbox deployment in customer VPC (VPC peering + IAM review)
- Week 2: Ingest sample traffic (replay from hosted logs) + validate p95 latencies and KV cache effectiveness
- Week 3: Cost modeling run (1M and 5M token scenarios) + fallback behavior test (model variant switch)
- Week 4: Security assessment sign-off + procurement pricing review

Key quotes / call snippets:
- "We need predictable spend for our next pricing tier — spikes are killing margins." — Maya Chen (Head of Product)
- "If we can hit p95 < 500ms consistently, we can roll the feature to enterprise customers." — Ibrahim Saleh (ML)
